title: LightGBM estimates treatment-machine leaf errors in separate patient plans
summary: A LightGBM model predicted logged multi-leaf collimator position errors in radiotherapy plans from previously unseen patients. Six held-out plans had mean absolute error 0.054 mm; nine additional patient plans supported dose-recalculation agreement. These are machine-log and calculated-dose validation results, with no measured patient benefit or independent physical dose validation.
organization: Shahid Beheshti University; Shahid Beheshti University of Medical Sciences; Tehran University of Medical Sciences; Amirkabir University of Technology

source_review.scope: Read actual primary patient/plan partition, signed-error/log reference, LightGBM tuning/feature selection, separate nine-patient dosimetric Methods, Results and limitations. Original article-meta online October27 is distinguished from November collection date. Supplementary raw logs were not independently inspected. Exact primary identity/date and fresh primary PubMed correction/retraction relationships checked.

evidence.tested: Twenty-nine patient plans were split by patient/plan into 23 development and six held-out test plans. GroupKFold tuning and development-only feature selection preceded final fitting. Against delivered-position machine logs, test MAE was 0.054 mm and RMSE 0.144 mm. Nine further patients supplied independent plans over six fractions; predicted and logged leaf positions were separately inserted into plans for dose recalculation on patient CTs. Agreement concerns reconstructed dose distributions, not in-vivo measured dose.
evidence.unknown: Single treatment center and accelerator; many leaf/control-point observations derive from few patients. Machine logs are the position reference and both dose distributions use the same dose-calculation system, so no independent physical dosimetry or outcome benefit is established. Dosimetric deviations were small and gamma agreement already high for delivered plans; the study does not establish detection of clinically dangerous failures or safer treatment.
evidence.ai_role: LightGBM learned plan/mechanical/initialization features to estimate delivered leaf-position errors; predicted positions enabled patient-plan dose recalculations compared with log-derived delivery estimates.
